headline: AI势头回落并非牛熊分界
abstract: 中信证券表示，AI趋势回落并非熊市开端，非AI可能反而会面临更为有利的环境，核心是AI产业在短期内并不像过往的产业趋势对经济体的其他部门产生广泛的拉动作用，反而对其他经济部门产生了不少负外部性（物料和资源价格暴涨、利率飙升、就业挤出）。这也意味着，过往“产业趋势行情结束=牛转熊”的经验可能不再适用，非AI的不少板块早已步入下行趋势。

abstract: A Tiny biped duck robot 🦆https://pollen-robotics.com/microduck Microduck A tiny biped robot that moves using reinforcement learning policies. Get yours here · Cheat sheet · Training the policies · How it works · Contributing This repo is the duck's brain. About 25 cm and 800 g of robot, run by a handful of daemons on a Rockchip RK3566: a 50 Hz control loop driving fifteen servos from neural policies, the radios and the camera, and the update machinery that gets new software onto a robot without bricking it. Everything you need to run a Microduck is here. If you want one, get yours here. The policies it runs are trained next door, in microduck_rl — MuJoCo and PPO, the sim2real recipe, and the export to ONNX that this repo loads. It does things It walks. Pick up a gamepad and drive. It rolls. Put wheels on, ask for roller mode, and it loads the other brain. It picks things up. Beak to the floor, one button. It gets back up. Knock it over and it stands itself up. It also sits, kicks a ball, rolls forward on command, and quacks in a voice that is its own. Where to find things...

headline: makecindy/cindy
abstract: Consider it done. She brings multiple harnesses, models and tools into one agent that finishes real work in your projects and apps. Ready from day one, yours to shape over time. Cindy runs locally on your own machine, using your real files and logged-in apps. The first supported harnesses are Claude Code and Codex — more are being added, and a native harness is in the works. Models and harnesses mix freely and can switch mid-task while your workspace, memory, skills and tools stay continuous; one task can even be planned, executed in parallel, and reviewed by agents on different harness × model combos. She can drive your browser, computer and phone, and take work from IM and schedules. This repository is the open-source client for Cindy — the desktop and mobile apps plus their shared packages, organized as a pnpm monorepo.
